worlds.name: Sequences
worlds.intro: A program is a list of steps. The robot does them in order, one by one.

worlds.name: Loops
worlds.intro: Repeat does the blocks inside it again and again, so you need far fewer blocks.

worlds.name: Functions
worlds.intro: F1 is your own block. Build it once in the F1 row, then use it as often as you like.

worlds.name: Mixed-up Code
worlds.intro: All the right blocks are here, but in a muddle. Tap a block and move it until the order is right.

worlds.name: Shrink It
worlds.tip: Repeat and F1 make it shorter.
worlds.intro: These programs work, but they are far too long. Make them short and neat with Repeat and F1.

worlds.name: Pixel Painter
worlds.intro: Paint colours the square the robot is on. Paint every dotted square to finish the picture.

worlds.name: Conditions
worlds.tip: Let an If do the work.
worlds.intro: If lets the robot look before it moves, so one short program can find its own way.

worlds.name: Robot Team
worlds.tip: Let an If do the work.
worlds.intro: Every robot runs the same program, one after the other. Write one program that works for them all.

worlds.name: Counters
worlds.intro: The robot can remember a number called n. Plus one makes it bigger, and Repeat n uses it.

worlds.name: Code Reader
worlds.intro: Read the program like a real coder. Where will the robot stop? Tap that square, then check.

worlds.name: Debugging
worlds.intro: These programs have bugs. Run them, spot what goes wrong and fix them with few changes.
